label: Detect aggregates
purpose: Find groups of a population's cells packed close together, or cells alone
useWhen: Aggregates by centre-to-centre distance, per timepoint for movies
Single cells with nothing near them, e.g. debris away from intact cells
You need an aggregated or isolated population for later steps
notWhen: Grouping by measured features: use Cluster cells
Large or live cells where surfaces matter: use Detect aggregates (meshes)

params.label: Name
params.tip: Output name; each name keeps its own columns and settings

params.label: Population
params.tip: The population to detect aggregates of

params.label: Neighbourhood (µm)
params.tip: Cells within this distance link into one aggregate

params.label: Min cells
params.tip: Fewest cells that make an aggregate

params.label: Max cells
params.tip: Larger groups don't count; 0 = no limit

params.label: Per timepoint
params.tip: Detect aggregates within each frame; off = pool all frames

params.label: Near population
params.tip: Optional: cells near these are left out, e.g. intact cells

params.label: Link across frames
params.tip: Follow each aggregate and isolated cell over frames

params.label: Max gap (frames)
params.tip: Frames an event may vanish and still continue

params.label: Max step (µm)
params.tip: Furthest an event moves between frames

params.label: Preceded by
params.tip: Optional: was this population there before the event began?

params.label: Look back (frames)
params.tip: Frames before the event to look in

params.label: Look within (µm)
params.tip: Distance from where the event began
